## Runs 6, 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Run 6 (`data/6`): B 0 → 10 T at the electron spot (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166). Run 7 (`data/7`): B 10 → 0.3 T riding down at the hole spot (−0.277, −0.465). Both complete, uninterrupted, leak-free (guard never tripped), signal ≤ 12 % of the 50 µV full scale. Raw R_xx(B) first, then the tone read (`sdh_onset` matched-filter track + FFT above onset).

# Runs 6 & 7 — SdH tone read: matched-filter onset track + FFT in 1/B above 1.5 T
from hera.analysis import sdh_fft, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, luttinger_frequency
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

F_L = {6: luttinger_frequency(3.2e16), 7: luttinger_frequency(1.2e16)}  # full-density Onsager (run-5 cal, geometry-prior scale)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for a, rid in zip(ax, (6, 7)):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    B = np.abs(r.col('magnet_field'))
    mc = r.meta['measurement_config']
    Rxx = (r.col('sr1_X') / 1.0) / (r.col('sr0_X') / mc['sr0_gain'])
    rfs = 50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(r.col('sr0_X') / mc['sr0_gain']))
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(Rxx, B, r_full_scale=rfs)
        print(f"--- run {rid} (F_L full-density = {float(F_L[rid]):.1f} T)")
        print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"run {rid}: sdh_onset failed: {e}")
    fr, sp = sdh_fft(Rxx[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, B.max()), nfft=2048)
    a.plot(fr, sp[0], lw=0.8)
    pk, pr = find_peaks(sp[0], height=sp[0].max() * 0.05)
    for i in np.argsort(pr['peak_heights'])[::-1][:6]:
        a.annotate(f"{fr[pk[i]]:.1f}", (fr[pk[i]], pr['peak_heights'][i]), fontsize=8)
    a.axvline(float(F_L[rid]), color='r', ls='--', lw=0.8, label=f'F_L = {float(F_L[rid]):.1f} T')
    a.set_xlim(0, 80); a.set_xlabel('F (T)'); a.set_ylabel('FFT mag'); a.legend()
    a.set_title(f'run {rid} SdH FFT, B 1.5-10 T')
fig.tight_layout()

**Read:** Both spots oscillate strongly from well below 1 T — a high-quality device. **Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** two candidate fundamentals, **F_a ≈ 7.1 T** (tracked to the 0.3 T record edge, harmonics at 14.1/22.1/29.5) and **F_b ≈ 30 T** (the strongest FFT peak), with 22.9 ≈ F_b−F_a and 37.0 ≈ F_b+F_a combination peaks. Two readings survive: (i) **two bands** F_a + F_b = 37.1 T carrying the full density (12 % above the geometry-prior F_L — inside the uncalibrated-scale error); (ii) one light band with unusually strong harmonics plus a heavy ~30 T band mimic. The FFT resolution over 1.5–10 T (δF ≈ 1.8 T) cannot separate 15.9 from 2×7.1. **Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** dominant **F ≈ 5.3 T** with harmonics (10.6, 21.2) plus distinct content at 14.1 and 8.5/12.3 — multiband, near-CNP, no single tone at F_L. Neither side matches a single-Fermi-surface (ABCA-like) picture at face value, but a two-point read is not a stacking call: **the discriminator is F(n) dispersion and the LL gap-line (filling-factor) structure across density — the Landau fan (next).** [runs `data/6`, `data/7`; cal run 5]

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B 0.2 → 10 T × n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹²

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 (181 pts co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal), B 0.2->10 T ascending, 84 rows (75 mT apex + uniform-1/B, F\_Nyq 40 T), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1 s, leak guard 1 nA; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~12:26** (≈7h)

**Why (plan step 4, operator-requested).** The spot checks (runs 6, 7; ana cells 14–17) show strong SdH on both carrier signs but leave the stacking read ambiguous: the e-side 7.1 + ~30 T content is two-band-like (sum 37.1 T vs full-density 33.1 T on the uncalibrated scale), yet a single light band with strong harmonics mimics it within the 1D FFT resolution. The fan resolves this three ways: **F(n) dispersion** of every fundamental, the **gap-line filling factors** ν = nh/eB and their degeneracy sequence, and **n-scale self-calibration** from integer ν (fan apex re-checks the run-5 CNP/offsets).

**Design.** Fast axis: 181-pt co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) line along the calibrated D = 0 (run-5 cal: ratio 0.773, n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm), n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² (Δn = 0.025×10¹²), V_tg ∈ [−0.291, +0.998], V_bg ∈ [−0.484, +1.185] — inside the validators with margin. Slow axis: 84 rows ascending from where the magnet sits — 0.2 → 0.95 T at 75 mT (11 rows, fan apex), then 1 → 10 T **uniform in 1/B** (73 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0125 T⁻¹ → F_Nyquist = 40 T at every field, covering the 30/37 T content; `sdh_fft` takes it without resampling). fast_delay 1.0 s / slow_delay 3.0 s (run-5 pacing; τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — same knowing bend as the gatemap). sr1 at **100 µV = 10 kΩ full scale** (run-4 lesson).

**Coverage trades, stated.** (i) n stops at the validator box (−1.25/+3.25) — the hole side is shallow, that's the committed envelope, not a choice. (ii) B starts at 0.2 T — the apex below that carries nothing at T_e ≈ 8 K. (iii) The main grid's 40 T Nyquist aliases the ~60 T second harmonic seen in run 6 — accepted; runs 6/7 are the dense 1D records for harmonic content. (iv) Near-CNP rows at high B may exceed 10 kΩ (ν = 0 gap) and clip — accepted: the read is gap **minima** positions, and full-range headroom would cost low-R resolution everywhere else.

**Price.** Row = 181 pts × 1.17 s/pt (run 5, measured, same delays) + ~4 s flyback + 6 s slow dwell ≈ 222 s; 84 rows ≈ 5.2 h + 72 min of ramps (0.137 T/min) ≈ 6.4 h; with the session's observed 5–10 % overrun: **≈ 7 h**, ending at **10 T, gates parked at 0**. **Checkpoints:** first 3 rows (~15 min: rail / leak / n-axis structure present) — abort there is the cheap kill; then hourly on the `hera-watch` digests + partial-fan re-forms (`fan_grids` drops the trailing partial row): continue / adjust / abandon, each priced. Leak guard trips the sweep at 1 nA on either Keithley.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 0.2 -> 10 T (84 rows) x n fast -1.25 -> +3.25e12 (181 pts) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.2), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, sr1 tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fast axis: D = 0 line, n -1.25 -> +3.25 e12 cm^-2, 181 pts (dn = 0.025e12) ---
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 181)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
_n_rt, _D_rt = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.max(np.abs(_D_rt)) < 1e-3 and np.max(np.abs(_n_rt - n_vec)) < 1e-6
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}], Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- slow axis: 0.2 -> 0.95 T at 75 mT (apex), then 1 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (F_Nyq = 40 T) ---
B_tail = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 0.951, 0.075), 4)
B_main = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(1.0, 0.1, 73), 4)
B_vec = np.unique(np.hstack((B_tail, B_main)))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_tail)} apex + {len(B_main)} uniform-1/B)")

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 100 uV = 10 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (run-4 lesson; near-CNP high-B rows may clip - accepted).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 (181 pts co-swept TG/BG, run-5 cal), "
                  "B 0.2..10 T (84 rows: 75 mT apex + uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.0125), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: B slow 0.2 -> 10 T, 84 rows (0.2-0.95 T at 75 mT + 1-10 T uniform 1/B, F_Nyq 40 T); '
              f'n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 cm^-2, 181 pts along D = 0; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
    print(f"end state: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (stays), gates parked at 0, "
          f"(I_tg, I_bg) = ({k_tg.curr():+.3e}, {k_bg.curr():+.3e}) A")
